title: Marginal subset probability
statement: Let $J$ be a subset of an $n$-element set and let $T$ be a subset of $J$. Under the distribution obtained by restricting a Shapley-random subset to $J$, the probability of obtaining $T$ is $1/((|J|+1)\binom{|J|}{|T|})$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a subset of the ground set
